name: DOMINO CRIBBAGE
description: Domino Cribbage is a hybrid game for two players that adapts the rules of the classic card game Cribbage to a set of double-six dominoes. Players score points by creating combinations of tiles (pairs, runs, and sums of 15) both during play and in their remaining hands. It is traditionally played with a cribbage board for scoring.

content.text: Domino Cribbage is a hybrid game for two players that adapts the rules of the classic card game Cribbage to a set of double-six dominoes. Players score points by creating combinations of tiles (pairs, runs, and sums of 15) both during play and in their remaining hands. It is traditionally played with a cribbage board for scoring.
Derived from Six-Card Cribbage, which dates back to the early 17th century (invented by Sir John Suckling). The domino adaptation emerged as a portable alternative for pub play.

Two players. One is designated the dealer, the other the non-dealer; they exchange roles after each hand. All 28 tiles are mixed, each player draws six tiles, then each discards two face down into the crib.
A standard set of 28 double-six dominoes.

All 28 tiles are face-down and shuffled. Each player draws 6 tiles. Two from each hand are discarded into a four-tile 'Crib' belonging to the dealer. One tile is turned over from the boneyard as the 'Starter'.
